full_prompt_en: A square illustrated action poster centers the upper body of a muscular black-haired martial-arts hero. His hair rises in large sharp spikes, and his head tilts down to the left so that narrow eyes and a firm mouth give a concentrated expression. An orange sleeveless outer garment wraps over a dark navy undershirt, leaving a strong bare arm visible at right. Deep brown shadows and bright orange highlights model the clothing and skin in angular planes. Behind the main figure, smaller companion figures appear in a loose layered montage. Some have similarly spiky dark hair, one has bright blond hair, and another has green features; they vary in scale and face different directions. They are partly absorbed into broad golden ochre and warm brown brush swipes, so the image reads as a collective memory or cast grouping rather than one continuous physical scene. The paper-white ground remains open along the left and lower edges. Irregular paint marks around the montage range from translucent washes to rough dry-brush streaks, with orange flares near the base of the central figure. At the lower right is a single bold red angular letterform resembling a stylized Z, edged in dark color; it is the only clear graphic mark. The poster uses anime anatomy and crisp black contours, but the compositing is painterly and textured. Strong diagonals from hair spikes, shoulders, and brush marks carry energy even though the main pose is still. The largest face dominates attention, while the smaller heads add depth and a sense of ensemble. No detailed background location appears. The overall effect is heroic, nostalgic, and forceful, combining clean character design with expressive golden paint.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形动作插画海报以一位肌肉结实、黑发武斗英雄的上半身为中心。头发竖成巨大的尖刺，他向左低头，狭长眼睛与紧闭嘴唇带出凝神表情。橙色无袖外衣压在深海军蓝内衫上，右侧露出强壮手臂。深褐阴影与亮橙高光以棱角分明的平面塑造衣服和皮肤。主角背后，多名较小的同伴以松散层叠蒙太奇出现。有的人也留尖锐深发，一人有亮金发，另一人呈绿色特征；他们大小不一，朝向不同。人物部分融进宽阔金赭与暖褐扫笔中，因此画面读作群像记忆或角色集合，而非连续的真实场景。纸白背景在左侧与下缘保持敞开。蒙太奇周围不规则颜料痕从半透明色洗到粗糙干笔皆有，中央人物底部附近出现橙色火焰般重音。右下角有一个醒目的红色棱角字形，形似风格化字母 Z，边缘带深色；这是唯一清楚的图形符号。海报运用动漫人体结构与清利黑轮廓，但组合方式带绘画肌理。发尖、肩线和扫笔形成强对角，即使主姿势静止也具有能量。最大面孔主导注意力，小头像增添深度和团队感。没有具体背景地点。整体英勇、怀旧而有力，把清晰角色设计与富表现性的金色颜料结合。
style_prompt_en: A high-energy anime poster blends crisp black character contours and angular cel-like shading with broad painterly washes. White paper remains visible around a clustered center; ochre, gold, orange, brown, dark navy, and black gather in rough-edged bursts. One large sharp silhouette commands the composition, while smaller overlapping fragments recede through scale and softer detail. Hairlike spikes, diagonal shoulders, and dry-brush streaks push the eye outward. Color is strongest at focal edges and fades into translucent, broken marks near the margins. Shading cuts across forms in bold planar steps, yet pigment grain and irregular wash borders keep the finish handmade. A small vivid red graphic accent adds poster energy. The result feels heroic and nostalgic, with movement supplied by shape rhythm and brush texture rather than a literal action moment.
style_prompt_zh: 高能量动漫海报把清利黑色角色轮廓、棱角分明的赛璐璐式明暗与宽笔绘画色洗相融。纸白留在集中画群周围；赭、金、橙、褐、深海蓝和黑聚成边缘粗糙的爆发色块。一处巨大尖锐剪影主导构图，较小碎片通过尺度与较柔细节层叠退后。刺状线形、倾斜肩线与干笔条痕把视线向外推。色彩在焦点边缘最浓，近画边渐变为半透明的断裂痕迹。阴影以醒目的平面阶梯切过形体，颜料颗粒与不规则色洗边界仍保留手工完成感。小面积鲜红图形重音添加海报能量。效果英勇而怀旧，动势来自形状节奏与笔触肌理，并非某个字面的动作瞬间。
theme_en: A spiky-haired martial-arts hero in orange before a layered cast montage and golden brush marks
theme_zh: 橙衣尖发武斗英雄立于多角色蒙太奇与金色笔痕前
name: Dragon Ball Z
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
